mapper.sql: id, evaluation_id, order_id, buyer_id, seller_id, rating, content, images, anonymous, status, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_evaluation(evaluation_id, order_id, buyer_id, seller_id, rating, content, images, anonymous, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{evaluationId}, #{orderId}, #{buyerId}, #{sellerId}, #{rating}, #{content}, #{images}, #{anonymous}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM order_evaluation WHERE status = 'VISIBLE' AND order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM order_item WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND is_deleted = 0) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_evaluation WHERE status = 'VISIBLE' AND order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM order_item WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND is_deleted = 0)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(AVG(rating), 0) AS average FROM order_evaluation WHERE status = 'VISIBLE' AND order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM order_item WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND is_deleted = 0)
